messages:
Lucas Kim: quick proposal 1: "Serving LLMs: Cost Controls for Product Teams" workshop. 60m, two tracks: engineering hands-on lab + product ROI. goal: demo requests and qualified infra/product leads. thoughts?
Priya Sharma: love the two-track split. can we make eng track a short sandbox lab? attendees opt-in on reg form. need 2 engineers to monitor.
Rafael Ortiz: sandbox is fine but cap seats (50). ops cost estimate required. also capture sandbox signups for Solutions Eng routing.
Kim Nguyen: ops q: hosted sandbox vs ephemeral containers? hosted easier for reliability. will calculate cost and provisioning time.
Evan Brooks: marketing ops: promo timeline - week -3 announce, week -2 paid + partners, week -1 reminders, day of last-chance. plan two LinkedIn bursts.
Maya Li: run-of-show (60m):
```
00:00 - intro & outcomes (5m)
05:00 - product narrative (10m)
15:00 - split: eng deep-dive OR product ROI (20m)
35:00 - live lab demo (10m)
45:00 - breakout office hours (10m)
55:00 - CTA + next steps (5m)
```
Lucas Kim: registration fields: email, company, role, company size, cloud infra, hosting preference, sandbox opt-in, breakout choice, utm params.
Priya Sharma: if sandbox_opt_in == true -> tag "hands-on" and notify Solutions Eng. if hosting_pref == "private" or company_size > 1000 -> route to Enterprise AE.
Rafael Ortiz: bench + demo owners: I'll handle benchmarks and fallback plan if sandbox fails (recorded demo + Q&A).
Kim Nguyen: webhook mapping snippet for ops: form.email -> crm.lead.email, form.company -> crm.lead.company_name, form.sandbox_opt_in -> crm.custom.hands_on, utm_campaign -> crm.source.campaign.
Evan Brooks: KPI targets: 600 regs, 220 live attendees, 65 sandbox signups, 30 demo requests. post-webinar: send recording + 3 clips, sandbox invites -> follow-up flow.
Maya Li: creative needs: hero banner, social snippets, teaser gif of demo, two landing pages (lab-first & outcome-first). deadline: assets in drive by Tue.
Lucas Kim: rehearsal plan: tech check 2 days prior (20m), full dress 3 days prior (60m), greenroom 15m before. eng-oncall on standby for sandbox.
Priya Sharma: will upload lab script and sandbox access instructions tonight.
Rafael Ortiz: I'll book #webinar-support and prepare rollback steps.
Nora-bot: calendar created: "Serving LLMs: Cost Controls workshop  rehearsal" scheduled 2024-07-09T16:00Z. link: https://calendar.redwoodinference/internal/xyz789
Lucas Kim: owners: Priya = lab & script, Kim = ops/webhooks, Rafael = bench & fallback, Evan = KPIs/tracking, Maya = creative/promo, Lucas = speaker coordination + customer outreach. update thread by Wed COB.
Maya Li: will coordinate partners for co-promo and ABM list for target accounts.
Lucas Kim: thanks team 1 closing loop: I'll draft promo copy and share in this channel tomorrow. :partyparrot:
